verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query Pulumi Cloud stacks and resources, search cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and delegate tasks to Neo. It names supported clients including Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf and Claude Desktop, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Pulumi Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered coding assistants to access your Pulumi Cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and optionally delegate tasks to Pulumi Neo.
Pulumi’s MCP server implementation provides AI assistants with the ability to: Query your Pulumi Cloud stacks and their resources, Search across all cloud resources
The Pulumi MCP server works with various AI-powered development tools: **Cursor**...**Anthropic’s Claude Code**...**Windsurf**...**Claude Desktop**
